title: Answer nine questions from a local corpus with outdated, conflicting and missing information

requirements.text: Q1 default port in 3.2, from an official source
Q2 default max_batch_size in 3.2, resolving the conflict between official sources by recency
Q3 whether kestrel.sync is usable on 3.2
Q5 a setting no source mentions is reported as UNKNOWN
Q6 contradictory community claims are reported as UNKNOWN
Q8 default maximum number of connections
Q9 a single community claim is reported as unconfirmed, not as confirmed
answers.json has the required shape and cites only files that exist
